convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (EMA_Prediction) which is a custom indicator, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position open/close logic and money management.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite signal close: UpValue signal closes existing short, DnValue signal closes existing long. Additional bar-by-bar scan (from SignalBar+1 onward) checks for opposing signals to set close flags if both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are enabled and no direct close signal was found on the signal bar.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM parameter), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM parameter serves dual purpose: negative values=fixed lots, positive values=percentage fraction of margin/balance depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals are read from EMA_Prediction custom indicator buffers (buffer 1=Up/buy signal, buffer 0=Down/sell signal) at SignalBar offset (default bar 1 = previous completed bar). Signals are non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE. When both open and close flags for the same side are enabled (BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose), and no close signal was found on the current signal bar, the EA scans forward through historical bars to find the most recent opposing signal to determine if a close should have occurred. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as feature toggles to enable/disable each direction. The signal timestamp is set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec, passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen for position management. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on CopyBuffer failures. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests persistent state management via global variables for position tracking.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of the EMA_Prediction custom indicator logic (two EMAs with prediction logic - must obtain the .mq5 source). TradeAlgorithms.mqh position open/close functions must be reimplemented: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose with margin mode logic, lot calculation, and order execution. The CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory function also need Python equivalents. Signal logic reads from indicator buffer indices 0 and 1, so the custom indicator calculation must be faithfully reproduced. The multi-bar scan for close signals (lines 127-153) is important to replicate exactly. No digit adjustment is done on SL/TP values - they are passed directly in points.
